summary: Chunk p02/ch02 k2 (units 39-76): 6 errors, 28 minor issues. Errors: unmarked conjectural readings in translations (u40, u52, u60, u69), unhedged probable anatomy and ungrammatical Hindi (u57, u60), mis-built translation of u76. No botanical names in chunk, so no plant identification errors. Anatomy equivalents (garbhāśaya uterus, aparā placenta, kāyāgni, śukra/retas) are correct; garbha-koṣṭha, nāḍī=umbilical cord, pakvāśaya=large intestine, dhamanī now hedged in both languages; niṣeka retagged standard. Counts as printed (none in this chunk). Units needing a human decision: 48 (anubhavan/asya agreement), 55 (tasmin, locative absolute), 64 (payobhūta; copula policy), 69 (atyunnatatatkukṣi; puruṣānabhilāṣiṇī), 76 (object of viguṇīkaroti; vātendriya). No regrouping needed; 61-62-63 and 73-75 read as continuing sentences.

garbha-koṣṭha, nāḍī (umbilical cord), pakvāśaya (large intestine), dhamanī (blood vessels), prasūti-māruta (labour contractions): probable, hedged 'probably'/'सम्भवतः' in both languages; niṣeka = impregnation is standard.
aparā Hindi = जेर everywhere (not आँवल), as already fixed in the p02 ch02 k4 entry.
